Callout.Name: Wanted Person Seen
Callout.Message: Wanted person seen on a trail by a hiker.
Callout.Advisory: Male on foot, description matches a recent warrant.

Script.Line: I was on the trail and he was coming the other way.
He looked at me and then he turned round and went back.
I have seen the picture. It was him. I am sure of it.

Lines.Approach: The hiker is sure it was him. He is on foot and he is in no hurry.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
